title: WebSocket AcceptWebSocketAsync inside a single-threaded HttpListener leaks threads
description: Accepting a WebSocket upgrade with HttpListenerContext.AcceptWebSocketAsync inside the single-threaded engine loop — especially when each accept spins a per-request [PowerShell] runspace via BeginInvoke that is never disposed — pins a thread per connection. A browser reconnect storm then exhausts the thread pool and hangs the engine (the verified 8042 HANG). The engine now intentionally rejects /ws with HTTP 501 and relies on HTTP polling for liveness and progress.
detection_method: Regex scan for any AcceptWebSocketAsync( call. WebSocket acceptance is disallowed inside the single-threaded HttpListener engine; each occurrence must be reviewed and replaced with an HTTP 501 rejection or moved to a dedicated multi-threaded host.
preventionRule: Do not accept WebSocket upgrades inside the single-threaded HttpListener engine. Reject /ws with HTTP 501 and use HTTP polling, or host real-time push in a dedicated multi-threaded process.
